prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: temporary accommodation during repairs. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"Where a claim for insured damage makes your home unfit to live in, we may arrange temporary accommodation for you and your household while essential repairs are carried out. However, we do not pay for luxury facilities or costs unrelated to the insured loss."},{"type":"fact","content":"If alternative accommodation is required, you must take reasonable steps to reduce the cost and avoid unnecessary delay. We may ask you to consider comparable options within a practical distance from your home, school or workplace."},{"type":"fact","content":"Where the home can be occupied in part, we may only cover accommodation for the section of the household that cannot remain there safely.
